summary: Standards pass, tier.durability.04/.05/.07: the failure halves `return` early when run as root, so as root they report passed without exercising the failure path (04 and 05 print `skipped: running as root` and their names say skipped-as-root as the brief asks; the migrate half of 07 skips silently and its name does not say so). Checked: CI (.github/workflows/test.yml, `ubuntu-latest` hosted runner, no container, `cargo test --workspace`) runs as the non-root `runner` user, and I ran all three here as uid 501 with --no-capture: no skip line, all PASS. Blast radius: a root-run build (docker CI, a root dev shell) shows these three green with the failure path unexercised; nothing else checks it.
